basic_profile.bio: I'm a motorcycle enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. Recently got into the Reddit scene to connect with fellow riders and tech aficionados. I spend my evenings browsing Reddit, especially after a day of work as a mechanical engineer. I'm single and enjoy evening rides around the city. My interests include tinkering with bikes, playing VR games like Beat Saber, and collecting Hot Wheels. Not a morning person, so you'll rarely see me online before noon.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Mechanical Engineering from UT Austin and have worked on motorcycles for the past 5 years, both professionally and as a hobby. My expertise in Triumph motorcycles has grown through hands-on experience, online forums, and community events.
